name: What improvements should I make to my investment property before selling?

mainEntity.name: What improvements should I make to my investment property before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before selling, focus on improvements that offer a strong return on investment and appeal to a broad range of buyers. This often includes minor cosmetic updates like fresh paint, updated light fixtures, and modernizing kitchens or bathrooms. Prioritize necessary repairs that could deter buyers, such as fixing leaks or electrical issues. A professional real estate agent can offer tailored advice based on current buyer preferences in areas like Aventura or Boca Raton, helping you avoid overspending on renovations that may not significantly increase value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize high-ROI cosmetic updates and essential repairs before selling. A real estate agent can advise on appealing improvements for your specific market.
